propertyEvents.result: The $12,400.00 the bank confirmed above the books is the 4 payments that cleared in July ($12,400.00), plus check 1043 that was never presented ($700.00), less the bank charge the books never recorded ($700.00). Nothing is left unexplained. The last two are the same size and cancel, which is why cash appeared to tie with only the July clearings in view.

propertyEvents.result: $239,760.00 to HANGS Property Holdings LLC and $240.00 to HANGS General Partner Inc left by wire on June 30, 2026 and are in the books that day; together $240,000.00, the distributions in the trial balance. There are no transfers to test: one account at the bank, one cash account in the books. The 3 other July payments are not in the June books. propertyEvents.result: Look for cash that is held back, pledged or restricted, and what the statements would need to say
propertyEvents.locator: Closings!A8:D111; escrow number, closing date and price for every closing; cutoff note

propertyEvents.result: The bank reports no holds, liens, pledges, set-off or compensating balance, and no loans whose terms could restrict cash. The escrow company wired all 104 closings in full, $3,276,000.00, so nothing is held back for the seller. The statements show one cash line, $29,900.00, all of total assets. No restricted cash, so the statements need no restricted cash disclosure; the CPA decides.
propertyEvents.locator: Closings!A8:D111; escrow number, closing date and price for every closing; cutoff note

propertyEvents.result: Wires and receipts are in the right year · no transfers · no restricted cash
Ready for the CPA
Add up what was found and set it against materiality

Known misstatements add up to $700.00, 5.8% of the $12,000.00 materiality and under performance materiality of $9,000.00: the unrecorded bank charge (FEE-01). Proposed: debit a bank charges expense, credit cash. If the client declines, it goes on the summary of passed adjustments. Voiding stale check 1043 would put $700.00 back in cash against the warranty liability (STALE-01), so the two together leave cash at $29,900.00. Concluding is the CPA's job; the machine stops here.

tape.label: FEE-01 Bank Charge Not Recorded, Known
